Extract/review the VG250_LAN layer and convert it to GeoJSON without changing the 16-Länder identity/code fields.
Run scripts/import_world_adm1.py with this contract's field mapping and expected count.
Review the generated DEU.geo.json and DEU.partition.json sidecar.
Confirm generated partition stays within the 1.5 MB partition budget.
Build a bounded DEU Places partition before promoting DEU into data/world-subdivisions/index.json.
Preserve the required BKG and dl-de/by-2-0 attribution on reader-facing provenance surfaces.
